# VidGo Technologies

> Complete e-commerce platform built and maintained in Romania: backend,
> storefront, and admin panel in one application, branded and configured per
> merchant. Hosting, security certificates, backups, updates, e-Factura (SPV)
> invoicing, digital returns (OUG 18/2026), abandoned-cart recovery, Google
> Merchant integration, AI-ready structured data and llms.txt — all included
> in one monthly subscription. No plugins to buy, no per-module licenses.

Founder and builder: Ioana Dinu, programmer and e-commerce specialist with
15+ years of experience (Jumbo NL, projects for IBM Netherlands clients).

## Services

- Store construction and full migration from PrestaShop, WooCommerce, Magento
  and similar platforms — products, customers, and order history transfer
  intact, without stopping sales.
- Monthly maintenance covering platform updates, legal-compliance features,
  speed and SEO optimisation, direct support from the platform's builder.

## Reference

- Live merchant store: https://biotu.ro/ — 7,000+ products migrated from
  PrestaShop; PageSpeed 95 performance / 100 SEO, publicly verifiable.
